newsitem.title: GERMANY: Camdessus - EMU can stabilise world forex system.
newsitem.headline: Camdessus - EMU can stabilise world forex system.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) President Michel Camdessus said on Friday that European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) offered a chance for a stabilisation of the world currency system.
Camdessus also said that delaying EMU, which is scheduled to start on January 1, 1999, would be a setback rather than a catastrophe.
Camdessus described EMU "as an outstanding factor for stability, economic strength and growth not only in Europe, but in the world."
He added, "A delay of EMU would not be a catastrophe, but a serious setback."
Camdessus was speaking to reporters ahead of a news conference to be held at a party conference of finance minister Theo Waigel's Christian Social Union which he is attending.
"1997 will be the year of truth for EMU," Camdessus said. He also called for "fiscal rectitude in the context of a stability culture." -- Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
